_meta.purpose: Coarse, user-facing groupings for the plant catalogue. The bundled taxonomy carries a GBIF harvest 'group' that is an internal collection bucket, not something a grower would search for. These categories are what the app browses and filters on: food crops, vegetables, fruits, herbs, spices, agricultural crops, rooftop/container plants, ornamentals and the rest.
_meta.scope: Categories describe use, not taxonomy. A plant may hold several at once, and exactly one may be flagged is_primary as the label shown on a browse card. No species is created or removed by this file; it only classifies species already staged from GBIF.
_meta.membership_rule: Explicit per-species membership in crop_coverage.json wins. Everything else falls back to the GBIF harvest group mapped in build_sqlite.py, so an unclassified species still lands in a real bucket rather than 'uncategorised'.
_meta.rooftop_rule: ROOFTOP_GARDEN is granted only where rooftop_greenery.json or crop_coverage.json carries explicit siting evidence for that species. Membership is never inferred from a species merely being a herb or a succulent, because a wrong 'grows on your balcony' claim is worse than an absent one.
_meta.provenance: Category assignment is project-curated grouping of GBIF-accepted taxa. It records no new biological claim, so it is stored as UNVERIFIED_CATEGORY rather than VERIFIED.
_meta.data_release_notes: Data release 2026.10.1 introduces categories, aliases, traits, crop attributes and rooftop suitability.

categories.label: Food crop
categories.description: Grown by people as food. Covers grains, pulses, oilseeds, vegetables, fruits, herbs and spices, so it is the broadest food grouping and overlaps the specific ones below.

categories.label: Cereal / grain
categories.description: Grains harvested for their starchy seed: rice, wheat, maize, barley, sorghum, millets, ricebean and relatives.

categories.label: Pulse / legume
categories.description: Grain legumes harvested for seed: chickpea, lentil, pigeon pea, mung bean, urdbean, pea, bean, soybean and groundnut.

categories.label: Oilseed
categories.description: Grown for seed oil: groundnut, soybean, mustard, sesame, sunflower, castor, cotton and linseed relatives.

categories.label: Vegetable
categories.description: Vegetable crops grown for roots, leaves, stems, flowers or fruit.

categories.label: Fruit
categories.description: Trees, vines and shrubs grown for their fruit.

categories.label: Herb
categories.description: Culinary and medicinal herbs harvested for leaves, stems or flowers: mint, coriander, basil, lemongrass and relatives.

categories.label: Spice
categories.description: Spice crops harvested for seed, bark, rhizome, flower bud or fruit: turmeric, ginger, pepper, cardamom, clove, cinnamon.

categories.label: Agricultural / cash crop
categories.description: Major commercial field crops of South Asian agriculture: cotton, sugarcane, jute, tobacco, castor and forage crops.

categories.label: Fibre crop
categories.description: Grown for fibre or bast: cotton, jute, ramie, hemp and sunn hemp relatives.

categories.label: Plantation crop
categories.description: Perennial plantation crops: tea, coffee, coconut, cardamom, black pepper, sandalwood.

categories.label: Fodder / forage
categories.description: Grown as animal feed, including many millets and fodder grasses.

categories.label: Rooftop / container garden
categories.description: Suited to rooftop, terrace, balcony, grow-bag or pot cultivation. Requires explicit siting evidence, never inferred.

categories.label: Ornamental
categories.description: Grown for flowers, foliage or form rather than for food.

categories.label: Indoor plant
categories.description: Tolerates being grown indoors in low light for a meaningful period.

categories.label: Medicinal / aromatic
categories.description: Used in traditional or modern herbal medicine. Recorded as a use category only, never as a safety or dosage claim.

categories.label: Aquatic / wetland
categories.description: Grows in or on standing water and wet margins.

categories.label: Wild / weedy
categories.description: Wild, volunteer and ruderal species. Several are edible weeds, and that is recorded separately where it applies.

categories.label: Tree
categories.description: Woody perennial growing to tree form.

categories.label: Shrub
categories.description: Woody perennial of multi-stemmed or shrub form.

categories.label: Climber / vine
categories.description: Weak-stemmed perennial that climbs with support, tendrils or twining stems.

categories.label: Succulent
categories.description: Water-storing tissue adapted to dry conditions; includes xerophytes and cacti.

gbif_group_map._comment: The GBIF harvest 'group' is an internal collection bucket. Mapping it to a public category keeps every one of the existing species classifiable even when no curated record exists, and stops the browse screen showing a single 'uncategorised' pile.
